entries.headline: Jake Bauers stayed in the yard
entries.story: Jake Bauers went 1-for-4 against Nick Martinez and the Tampa Bay Rays. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Junior Caminero came close
entries.story: Junior Caminero went 1-for-3 with 1 BB against Jacob Misiorowski and the Milwaukee Brewers. Closest call was a double in the 4th: "Junior Caminero doubles (4) on a sharp line drive to center fielder Garrett Mitchell. Jonathan Aranda to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.
